egress.terms: Free, explicitly unmetered. 'Unlimited Bandwidth / Never worry about traffic spikes or overage fees'; HLS delivery from their CDN.

record.tooling: XFileSharing-style api.html + PolyUploader (github.com/spel987/PolyUploader) lists StreamRuby; XFS '?op=api' key pattern applies
record.chaining: The quota scales with views rather than accounts, i.e. 250 GB + 250 GB per 1.5k monthly views. A view-inflation loop (or simply many free accounts) turns this into an unbounded pool; each account independently starts at 250 GB.
record.limits_note: 20,000 MB (20 GB) per file per the official plan table; video-only (HLS transcode); 60-day deletion when unviewed for free tier
record.reliability_note: video-only: everything is transcoded to HLS, so it is not byte-exact storage; free-tier storage allowance is recomputed monthly from views, so it can shrink (existing videos are not deleted)

evidence.proved: 'Start with 250 GB free and unlock another 250 GB for every 1,500 monthly views'; 'Unlimited Bandwidth'; 'A lower allowance won't delete your existing videos'
